note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; the original gives only the soldier description and measurements, the worker being known only from the original papers cited there (Silvestri 1901, 1903) and not restated here, so it is not listed. Measurements translated verbatim from Table 18 of the original, in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head large and thick, sides slightly curved and narrowed anteriorly, posterior margin rounded, frontal tube short and conical, not reaching the base of the clypeus; lateral margins of the sclerotized part of the labrum evenly curved, the white tip projecting. Larger than C. walkeri; the two form a group of closely related species with C. pugnax, the soldiers being distinguished mainly by characters of the labrum (Fig. 14 of the original) and mandibles (Fig. 15).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdomen pale yellow, pronotum slightly paler than the head; abdomen greyish because the gut contents show through. Head sparsely covered with setae, without visible short hairs; front of the postmentum with several setae and covered with very fine, almost invisible short hairs; pronotum with setae and short hairs on the anterior margin; tergites with setae; sternites with setae and short hairs. Head large and thick, sides slightly curved and narrowed anteriorly, posterior margin rounded. Frontal tube short, conical, not reaching the base of the clypeus. Narrowest part of the postmentum about 2/3 of the greatest width. Antennae 15-segmented. Lateral margins of the sclerotized part of the labrum evenly curved, the white tip projecting. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 18, n=6—32): head length including mandibles 4.51—4.85 (mean 4.68); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.80—3.05 (2.93); head length to the lateral mandibular bases 3.23—3.66 (3.41); head width 2.93—3.17 (3.04); head thickness 2.11—2.19 (2.16); frontal tube length 0.37—0.48 (0.42); labrum width 0.79—0.86 (0.84); left mandible length 1.65—1.82 (1.74); right mandible length from the notch 0.85—0.91 (0.88); pronotum length 0.79—0.86 (0.84); pronotum width 1.34—1.46 (1.40); hind tibia length 2.38—2.52 (2.64).
